title: Parity under a coordinate toggle
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $w\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ be a Boolean string, and choose a coordinate $i$. Toggling the bit of $w$ at $i$ changes its parity in $\mathbb{F}_2$ by $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean string of length n
